source: DHM Islamic Level 1 · lesson 14 «How We Pray». Video approved by Dr. Hassan (2026-10-11).
topic: Starting the prayer: takbir and standing (qiyam)

quiz.en: What do we say at the start of the prayer?
Where do we put our right hand?
opts: On the left hand, on our chest

quiz.en: Where do we look while standing?
opts: At the place where we prostrate

move.ar: قُمْ وَارْفَعْ يَدَيْكَ وَقُلْ: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ
move.en: Stand up, raise your hands, and say: Allahu Akbar!

parents.summary: How the prayer begins: saying Allahu Akbar with raised hands, then standing with the right hand over the left.
parents.tip: Ask him to show you how the prayer starts. Let him be the teacher.
